name: inbound-rate-limiting
title: Inbound request rate limiting (generous, env-tuned, default off)
description: Add inbound request rate limiting on /v1/* (and optionally /health) with generous env-tuned defaults that NEVER trip for legitimate single-caller use, default OFF (ARGUS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false) so existing behavior is unchanged until an operator opts in. Auth-401 path must not be throttled destructively. Finding #4.
creator: Howard Ju
